body:
2026-08-30 corrected independent review after authoritative GitHub raw-content re-read: NO-GO for refresh, merge, and deployment.

Correction: exact PR head b6bed30712e85bf9885211ceb35e739ac72e273f already uses valid kubectl Go-template index syntax in both account_state() and token_state(). The earlier invalid-syntax observation came from a stale local snapshot and is withdrawn. Real kubectl parsing confirms the indexed form succeeds and the old direct .data key form fails.

Remaining code/test gap: existing fake-kubectl transaction tests do not parse Go templates. Add a parser-level regression using real kubectl client-side/template parsing for present and absent account/token keys so this failure mode cannot regress.

Remaining gates:

- head b6bed307 is based on 073da10 and is 6 commits ahead / 14 behind canonical main 41f5274ffe88a7eb8194b18beab19635c5a3d11c with overlapping changes
- codicarium-management-break-glass does not exist in live environment inventory; required reviewer protection and secret/runner trust boundaries must be provisioned and verified before workflow use
- ARC evidence is stale/cancelled
- live Authentik admin/non-admin and independent local-admin break-glass evidence remain incomplete

Do not merge or dispatch the revocation workflow until the branch is refreshed with parser-level coverage and re-reviewed, environment protection and trusted runner/secret scope exist, and identity/break-glass gates pass.
